text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Almond Eye didn't show up for 
training. ...Apparently, she got 
completely caught up in a street race."
choice_data_list:
As long as you've learned from it, that's 
fine. Just make up for it tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, not tomorrow—I'll do it right now. 
Wait for me, I'll get ready right—
choice_data_list: 反省してるならいいよ、その分明日頑張ろう
choice_data_list_en: As long as you're reflecting on it, it's fine. Just make up for it tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: 今すべきことは、その疲労を取ることだよ
choice_data_list_en: What you need to do right now is get rid of that fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're right. That's exactly it. 
I'm truly sorry, Trainer.
